text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
!? W-What was that just now...? What on 
earth is this heat surging through my 
body...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...... No, before that, I have my 
Beautification Committee duties right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, Three 
Goddesses. I'll have you looking sparkling 
clean in no time.
